name: Material standard: DIN 1356
summary: How materials draw in cuts, plans and facades after DIN 1356-1: Lapin's built-in „DIN 1356” standard as a pack (indicative).
description: Masonry in 45° lines, aerated concrete in lines with dots, natural stone crossed by dashes; plain concrete speckled, reinforced concrete crosshatched; insulation as loops (soft) or zig-zag rows (rigid foam); timber grain; narrow metal sections filled solid from 1:50; facing brick 240 × 71 (NF). Material names in German and English. Indicative, drawn by Lapin from the general principles of the norm, not copied from it: check it against the standard your drawings must follow. Installed, it is added to the open project with „Add to this project” and applied from Manage → Drawing standards → Materials. Country: DE; norm: DIN 1356-1.

items: 34 rules (cut, plan and facade graphics by the material's name)
